# Make a modelling dataframe

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

current_dir = Path.cwd().parent

combined_path = (
    current_dir
    / "results"
    / "combined_dataset"
    / "Combined_dataset.csv"
)

output_dir = (
    current_dir
    / "results"
    / "combined_dataset"
)

model_df = pd.read_csv(combined_path)

print("Combined dataset shape:", model_df.shape)


# ============================================================
# IDS AND RESPONSE VARIABLES
# ============================================================

id_columns = [
    "Scan_id",
    "Participant_Id"
]

response_vars = [f"comp{i}" for i in range(1, 19)]

for col in response_vars:
    model_df[col] = pd.to_numeric(
        model_df[col],
        errors="coerce"
    )

print("Rows with missing response data:", model_df[response_vars].isna().any(axis=1).sum())
```

```{python}
# ============================================================
# CLEAN CATEGORICAL METADATA
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Sex
# Keep genuinely missing values as an explicit Missing category
# ------------------------------------------------------------

model_df["Sex"] = (
    model_df["Sex"]
    .astype("string")
    .str.strip()
    .str.upper()
    .replace({
        "FEMALE": "F",
        "MALE": "M",
        "MISSING": "Missing",
        "NA": "Missing",
        "N/A": "Missing"
    })
    .fillna("Missing")
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Rodent strain
# Keep genuinely missing values as an explicit Missing category
# ------------------------------------------------------------

model_df["Rodent.strain"] = (
    model_df["Rodent.strain"]
    .astype("string")
    .str.strip()
)

model_df.loc[
    model_df["Rodent.strain"].str.contains(
        "C57",
        case=False,
        na=False
    ),
    "Rodent.strain"
] = "C57BL/6"

model_df["Rodent.strain"] = (
    model_df["Rodent.strain"]
    .replace({
        "missing": "Missing",
        "MISSING": "Missing",
        "NA": "Missing",
        "N/A": "Missing"
    })
    .fillna("Missing")
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Coil
# Missing / N.A. = no cryocoil = RT
# ------------------------------------------------------------

model_df["Coil"] = (
    model_df["Coil"]
    .astype("string")
    .str.strip()
    .str.lower()
    .replace({
        "y": "Cryo",
        "yes": "Cryo",
        "cryo": "Cryo",
        "n": "RT",
        "no": "RT",
        "rt": "RT",
        "missing": "RT",
        "na": "RT",
        "n/a": "RT"
    })
    .fillna("RT")
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# fMRI sequence
# Plain EPI = GE-EPI.
# Truly missing values stay Missing unless corrected upstream.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

model_df["fMRI.sequence"] = (
    model_df["fMRI.sequence"]
    .astype("string")
    .str.strip()
    .str.upper()
    .replace({
        "EPI": "GE-EPI",
        "GE EPI": "GE-EPI",
        "GE-EPI": "GE-EPI",
        "SE EPI": "SE-EPI",
        "SE-EPI": "SE-EPI",
        "ME EPI": "ME-EPI",
        "ME-EPI": "ME-EPI",
        "MISSING": "Missing",
        "NA": "Missing",
        "N/A": "Missing"
    })
    .fillna("Missing")
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Anesthesia
# Missing / N.A. = Awake
# ------------------------------------------------------------

model_df["Anesthesia"] = (
    model_df["Anesthesia"]
    .astype("string")
    .str.strip()
    .str.lower()
    .replace({
        "awake": "Awake",
        "iso": "Iso",
        "dex": "Dex",
        "dexiso": "Dexiso",
        "med": "Med",
        "mediso": "Mediso",
        "hal": "Hal",
        "propofol": "Propofol",
        "missing": "Awake",
        "na": "Awake",
        "n/a": "Awake"
    })
    .fillna("Awake")
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Ventilation
# Missing / N.A. = No
# ------------------------------------------------------------

model_df["Ventilation"] = (
    model_df["Ventilation"]
    .astype("string")
    .str.strip()
    .str.lower()
    .replace({
        "y": "Yes",
        "yes": "Yes",
        "n": "No",
        "no": "No",
        "missing": "No",
        "na": "No",
        "n/a": "No"
    })
    .fillna("No")
)
```

```{python}
# ============================================================
# NUMERIC COVARIATES
# ============================================================

numeric_covariates = [
    "Age(week)",
    "MRI",
    "MRI T.R.",
    "FD average",
    "FD maximum"
]

for col in numeric_covariates:
    model_df[col] = pd.to_numeric(
        model_df[col],
        errors="coerce"
    )


# ============================================================
# HANDLE MISSING NUMERIC VALUES
# ============================================================

original_missing = {}
all_missing_numeric = []
numeric_missing_indicators = []

for col in numeric_covariates:

    original_missing[col] = {
        "N_missing": model_df[col].isna().sum(),
        "Percent_missing": model_df[col].isna().mean() * 100
    }

    if model_df[col].isna().all():
        all_missing_numeric.append(col)
        continue

    if model_df[col].isna().any():

        missing_col = col + "_Missing"

        model_df[missing_col] = (
            model_df[col]
            .isna()
            .astype(float)
        )

        numeric_missing_indicators.append(missing_col)

        # Dataset-specific median first
        model_df[col] = model_df[col].fillna(
            model_df
            .groupby("Dataset_name")[col]
            .transform("median")
        )

        # Global median if an entire dataset has no value
        model_df[col] = model_df[col].fillna(
            model_df[col].median()
        )


numeric_covariates = [
    col for col in numeric_covariates
    if col not in all_missing_numeric
]


# ============================================================
# NUMERIC MISSINGNESS SUMMARY
# ============================================================

missing_summary = []

for col in original_missing:

    if col in all_missing_numeric:
        action = "Excluded - all values missing"

    elif col + "_Missing" in numeric_missing_indicators:
        action = "Dataset median / global median + missing indicator"

    else:
        action = "No missing values"

    missing_summary.append([
        col,
        original_missing[col]["N_missing"],
        original_missing[col]["Percent_missing"],
        action
    ])

missing_summary = pd.DataFrame(
    missing_summary,
    columns=[
        "Variable",
        "N_missing",
        "Percent_missing",
        "Action"
    ]
)

display(missing_summary)
```

```{python}
# ============================================================
# CATEGORICAL COVARIATES
# ============================================================

categorical_covariates = [
    "Sex",
    "Rodent.strain",
    "Coil",
    "fMRI.sequence",
    "Anesthesia",
    "Ventilation"
]


# Explicit reference categories.
# This avoids the reference changing simply because alphabetic
# order or available categories change.
reference_levels = {
    "Sex": "F",
    "Rodent.strain": "C57BL/6",
    "Coil": "RT",
    "fMRI.sequence": "GE-EPI",
    "Anesthesia": "Awake",
    "Ventilation": "No"
}


# ============================================================
# CHECK CLEANED VALUES BEFORE ENCODING
# ============================================================

for col in categorical_covariates:

    print("\n" + col)
    print(model_df[col].value_counts(dropna=False))

print("\nNumeric missing indicators:")
print(numeric_missing_indicators)

print("\nRemaining NaNs in numeric covariates:")
print(model_df[numeric_covariates].isna().sum())
```

```{python}
# ============================================================
# DUMMY ENCODING
# ============================================================

encoded_covariates = (
    numeric_covariates.copy()
    + numeric_missing_indicators.copy()
)

encoding_table = []

for col in categorical_covariates:

    reference = reference_levels[col]

    observed = (
        model_df[col]
        .dropna()
        .unique()
        .tolist()
    )

    if reference not in observed:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Reference category '{reference}' not found for {col}. "
            f"Observed categories: {observed}"
        )

    # Reference first, Missing last, everything else in between
    other_categories = sorted(
        [
            value for value in observed
            if value not in [reference, "Missing"]
        ]
    )

    categories = [reference] + other_categories

    if "Missing" in observed:
        categories.append("Missing")

    print("\n" + col)
    print("Reference:", reference)
    print("Categories:", categories)

    model_df[col] = pd.Categorical(
        model_df[col],
        categories=categories
    )

    dummies = pd.get_dummies(
        model_df[col],
        prefix=col,
        drop_first=True,
        dtype=float
    )

    model_df = pd.concat(
        [model_df, dummies],
        axis=1
    )

    encoded_covariates.extend(
        dummies.columns.tolist()
    )

    encoding_table.append([
        col,
        reference,
        "Reference"
    ])

    for dummy in dummies.columns:

        category = dummy.replace(
            col + "_",
            "",
            1
        )

        encoding_table.append([
            col,
            category,
            dummy
        ])


# ============================================================
# FINAL MODEL VARIABLES
# ============================================================

covariates = encoded_covariates

batch_effects = [
    "Dataset_name"
]

encoding_table = pd.DataFrame(
    encoding_table,
    columns=[
        "Variable",
        "Category",
        "Encoding"
    ]
)
```

```{python}
# ============================================================
# VALIDATE ENCODING
# ============================================================

print("\n======================================")
print("FINAL MODEL SETUP")
print("======================================")

print("\nNumber of rows:")
print(len(model_df))

print("\nNumeric covariates:")
print(numeric_covariates)

print("\nNumeric missing indicators:")
print(numeric_missing_indicators)

print("\nTotal number of encoded covariates:")
print(len(covariates))

print("\nCovariates:")
print(covariates)

print("\nBatch effects:")
print(batch_effects)

print("\nResponse variables:")
print(response_vars)

print("\nEncoding table:")
display(encoding_table)


# Explicit check for Sex encoding
sex_dummy_columns = [
    col for col in covariates
    if col.startswith("Sex_")
]

print("\nSex dummy columns:")
print(sex_dummy_columns)

print("\nSex encoding check:")
print(
    model_df[
        ["Sex"] + sex_dummy_columns
    ]
    .drop_duplicates()
    .sort_values("Sex")
)
```

```{python}
# ============================================================
# CREATE FINAL MODELLING DATAFRAME
# ============================================================

model_columns = (
    id_columns
    + batch_effects
    + covariates
    + response_vars
)

final_model_df = model_df[
    model_columns
].copy()


# ============================================================
# FINAL SAFETY CHECKS
# ============================================================

if final_model_df[covariates].isna().any().any():
    raise ValueError("NaNs remain in model covariates")

if final_model_df[response_vars].isna().any().any():
    raise ValueError("NaNs remain in response variables")

if final_model_df.columns.duplicated().any():
    raise ValueError("Duplicate columns found in Model_dataframe")


print("Final modelling dataframe shape:")
print(final_model_df.shape)

print("\nColumns:")
print(final_model_df.columns.tolist())

print("\nRemaining NaNs in model covariates:")
print(final_model_df[covariates].isna().sum().sum())


# ============================================================
# SAVE
# ============================================================

final_model_df.to_csv(
    output_dir / "Model_dataframe.csv",
    index=False
)

encoding_table.to_csv(
    output_dir / "Encoding_table.csv",
    index=False
)

missing_summary.to_csv(
    output_dir / "Missingness_summary.csv",
    index=False
)

print("\nSaved:")
print(output_dir / "Model_dataframe.csv")
print(output_dir / "Encoding_table.csv")
print(output_dir / "Missingness_summary.csv")
```
